{{Top}}
'''Solar collectors''',<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> also known as '''solar panels''',<ref name="BP">''[[Star Wars Blueprints]]''</ref> '''solar arrays''',<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> or '''solar collector panels''',<ref name="WEG">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref> were a clean, quiet form of energy collection.

[[Solar power generator]]s converted the energy collected by the solar panels into electrical power.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Used to power bases and strongholds with relatively cheap energy, [[Star/Legends|solar]] collectors were nonetheless inefficient, and often required bases to have a minimum of over fifty percent of its surfaces dedicated to collector panels. Additionally, the panels were not very well armored and were highly susceptible to damage.<ref name="FT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
